An {creature:Elf Arcanist} guards a treasure at the top of the central tower of the fortified Elvenbane castle, near Ab'Dendriel. Cross the cellar full of orcs and minotaurs, climb the tower past poison fields, a {creature:Dragon} and mages, and defeat the final team to open two chests and two drawers with a {item:Morning Star}, a {item:Dwarven Shield}, a {item:Spellbook} and more.
An Elf Arcanist hoards treasures in its heavily fortified castle.
Does not need Premium or a minimum level.
Level 35+ recommended (there is a Dragon in the tower).
useful for clearing the poison fields
to leave the basement through the entrance hole
Bring {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes} and something to cure poison: the first floor of the tower is covered in poison fields.
There is another quest in Elvenbane, the {wiki:To Blind the Enemy Quest|To Blind the Enemy Quest}, but for that one you have to talk to {npc:Eroth} first.
Start at the gate of **Ab'Dendriel**. Go **south**, then **west** and then **north** to Elvenbane castle, which sits on an island west of the city and can only be entered through an underground cave.
Go down the hole surrounded by **four stones**. You end up in the Elvenbane basement.
The hole surrounded by four stones, entrance to the basement

Run **north** and then **west** to the opening. Here you may meet an {creature:Orc Berserker} and a {creature:Minotaur Guard}, a few {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and an {creature:Orc Spearman}. Go around and enter the **middle tower**.
Path through the basement to the middle tower
The {creature:Orc Spearman} can break your shield.
The first floor of the tower is completely covered in poison fields. Walk across them or use {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes} to clear them. Get ready for the dragon on the floor above.
There is a {creature:Dragon} on this floor. There is no room to run around it, so sorcerers should cast 1 or 2 quick {spell:Energy Wave|Energy Waves}. Kill the dragon or run past it to the stairs.
The Dragon spits fire in an area: do not stand in front of it if you are weak.
Here there is an {creature:Orc Shaman} and a {creature:Minotaur Mage}. Kill them and keep going up the stairs.
Orc Shaman and Minotaur Mage floor
On the last floor there are 2 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and an {creature:Elf Arcanist}, the so-called "playerhunter team". Kill them.
Last floor with the chests and drawers

Open the **2 chests** and the **2 quest drawers** to receive the rewards: {item:Morning Star}, {item:Dwarven Shield}, {item:Strong Mana Potion}, {item:Blank Rune}, {item:Spellbook}, 2 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds} and 100 gold.
Morning Star, Dwarven Shield, Strong Mana Potion, Blank Rune, Spellbook, 2 Small Diamonds and 100 gold

Go back the same way: go down the central tower by the same stairs (careful again with the {creature:Dragon} and the poison fields), cross the basement back (**east** and then **south**) to the hole you fell through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up. Then return to Ab'Dendriel (**south**, **east** and **north** to the gate).
